design:
## Design tests

The cast of builder 0.45.0 and revision 43 were read blind in whole test scenes among other events (`vision/design_tests_v045.md`, six pictures, one fresh reader each). Three placed on their first seed, one on its second and one on its 25th: it asked for an ice cream in a child's hand beside a lost balloon and a slide, and the cast has two children, so the slide's rider became a reader on a bench. The sixth is a v0.44 probe's own seed, where the goat's stake had stood on a bench. Three flaws came out of the readings, all three were fixed in revision 43 before the set was built, and tests 3 and 4 were built and read again:
- **The lost balloon's string.** First reading, its end under the playground railing's rail: "Its string ends in a small curl/hook just above the fence rail". The end now lies nowhere on a railing (`templates.RAIL45`). Second reading: "looks like a hook rather than a loose end". The string now hangs in a slow wave with no curl (`templates.CURL45`). Third reading: "its string dangling loose, so it looks as though she has just let it go". The balloon read as lost in all three.
- **The bird table's foot.** "The green patch at the base of the birdhouse pole is unexplained" became "a tuft of grass at the base" (`settings.FOOT45`).
- **A child's ice cream and the camera:** "holding a pink ice-cream cone", a cone in all three readings, at the size v0.44's was "a lollipop"; "holding a camera up to his eye and taking a photo", "camera on a yellow strap".
- **The roller, the trowel and the reel:** "holding a paint roller and painting the fence blue. A few fence boards next to him are already blue, and a paint tin stands on the grass by his feet"; "kneels by a round flower bed full of colourful flowers and digs with a small trowel"; "a red-and-white kite handle".
- **The picnic, the duck, the box and the slide:** "A wicker picnic basket on the blanket holds a baguette and a green bottle"; "a white duck swimming on it"; "carrying a cardboard box" in all three readings; "a playground slide with a red ladder and frame and a yellow/orange chute".
- **The hose:** its cause read in both readings, "the dog seems to be squashing or kinking the hose and stopping the water"; the inspecting is one reading of two, "about to spray (and soak) the drying clothes or the woman, or she may simply be puzzled that no water is coming out".
- **The goat's stake:** "It is tied with a rope to a small stake in the ground", the bench not named with it.
intro: The forty-second screen read 93 pictures, the set's 21 and 72 probes, with twelve readers and four scorers: 992 of 1,009 scored items had full marks, and none was misread. All 64 templates pass the gate, for the first time since v0.41. `ice_cream`, v0.44's one failure, reads 1.00 in fourteen pictures, "a pink ice-cream cone" in a child's hand, and `photo` and `lost_balloon` read 1.00 in five each. The gate's first count failed `dog_reading` on one picture, its paper "up in the air", the paper v0.44's readers had twice called floating. After the screen the paper was drawn onto the dog's paws and the three pictures were read again: 1.00 in all three. `bird_steals`, which this release did not work, is the lowest at 0.933. Twelve of the 17 items under full marks are clouds or a tree that two readers left out.
redrawn: `ice_cream`, half as big again in a child's hand, reads 1.00 in fourteen pictures, a lollipop or a sweet in no description. `ice_cream_drop`, its empty cone larger as well, reads 1.00 in six. `photo` reads 1.00 in five, "holding a camera up to his eye, taking a photo, with a red strap hanging from it", binoculars in no description. `lost_balloon` reads 1.00 in five: "has escaped and is floating up into the sky, its string dangling". `dog_reading` reads 1.00 in three after the fix. `paint_fence` reads 1.00 in nine pictures and `plant_flowers` in five, the roller and the trowel named. `picnic` reads 1.00 in three, with "a plate with a slice of watermelon, and beside him a wicker picnic basket with a bottle and a baguette". `fly_kite` reads 1.00 in three, and the reel is "a kite reel" or "a kite spool" in six of the seven pictures with a kite on its string. `blocked_hose` reads 1.00 in seven pictures, `goat_grazing` and `ducks_swimming` in four each, `carry_box` and `slide` in three each. `bird_steals`, not worked, reads 0.933: 1.00 at the first count, and two half marks in one picture's re-read.
gate: Every template was screened in at least three pictures (38 in three, 11 in four, 10 in five, 1 in six, 1 in seven, 1 in nine, 1 in thirteen and 1 in fourteen), and all 64 pass, for the first time since v0.41. The first count was 63 and one failure, `dog_reading` at 0.833 with a misread; the table has the count after the fix and the three re-reads. The lowest that pass are `bird_steals` (0.933), `square_wheel` (0.933) and `cat_stalks_bird` (0.958), and every other template reads 1.00. Per angle (`vision/v045/gate_yaw.json`), 21 of the 22 (template, angle) pairs pass: the thief bird in profile reads 0.889 over 9 items in 3 pictures, on the re-read's two half marks, and 1.00 at the three-quarter angle. The gate is a filter, and the pilot with people is the test of difficulty.
inspection: Every cell of the set placed under revision 43: tiers 1 to 3 on their base seeds, but the tier-3 playground, which placed on the first seed of a fresh list, as in v0.44; the tier-4 garden, park and street on v0.44's seeds with the same templates. One prior moved after the set was built: the garden's lost balloon was lifted above the fence late (`templates.WOOD45`), and with the new prior the tier-3 garden's base seed gave other templates and the tier-4 playground placed on the 16th seed of its list. Both replace the earlier pictures. The five isomorphs pair the same cells as v0.44's, two of them on v0.44's seeds. The probe pass gave `ice_cream`, `photo`, `lost_balloon`, `plant_flowers` and `paint_fence` five pictures each and built 54, the pass stratified by angle added 13, and five more were forced for the wash line and the fishing: 72 probes. Every picture was looked at before the screen. All 93 records rebuild identical to the pixel, and the library passes the validator in full, 382 of 382.
calib: With the lost balloon's string ending higher above the hand and, in the garden, above the fence, 26 fields of the calibration moved by 0.002 or more, most of all `lost_balloon`'s inference (s from -1.20 to -1.14, d from 0.146 to 0.185).
